comparison_metadata.evaluation_name: Sentinel-1 Real SAR vs U-Net Training Representation Audit

training_representation.polarization: Pre-rendered RGB (VV/VH false color or grayscale mapped to 3 channels)
training_representation.geometric_assumptions: Cartesian pixel grid with geographic bounding box mapping

real_sentinel1_grd_representation.crs: None (slant-to-ground range with GCP table in annotation XML)
real_sentinel1_grd_representation.browse_quicklook_format: PNG 8-bit RGB (~511x397 px), downsampled by ESA IPF

domain_mismatches_identified.mismatch: Raw GRD is 16-bit unsigned (0-65535 DN) vs Training 8-bit (0-255).
domain_mismatches_identified.impact: Direct feeding of raw DN causes total saturation in U-Net (values 100x above network norm).
domain_mismatches_identified.resolution: Percentile-based linear scaling [p2, p98] or radiometric sigma0 dB compression to [0.0, 1.0].

domain_mismatches_identified.mismatch: Raw measurement is 1-band (VV) vs U-Net expecting 3 channels.
domain_mismatches_identified.resolution: Channel duplication [VV, VV, VV] or dual-pol fusion [VV, VH, VV/VH ratio].

domain_mismatches_identified.mismatch: Raw scene is ~25000x19000 px vs U-Net 256x256 px.
domain_mismatches_identified.impact: Single full-scene tensor cannot fit in standard GPU/CPU memory.
domain_mismatches_identified.resolution: Tiling into 256x256 chips or multi-scale evaluation with overlap.

domain_mismatches_identified.mismatch: Raw GRD has no projected CRS (stored with GCPs in XML).
domain_mismatches_identified.impact: Direct pixel-to-geographic projection requires GCP polynomial interpolation or product footprint bounding box mapping.
domain_mismatches_identified.resolution: Use product GeoFootprint polygon corners and tie-point interpolation to project detected pixels to WGS84.

compatibility_assessment.generalization_warning: Real Sentinel-1 compatibility demonstrated for tested IW GRD product representations. Model confidence may vary on scenes with different sea states or steep incidence angles.
